bugsFoundDuringValidation.launchServicesWritesFromUnbundledProcess: deprecated LSSetDefaultHandlerForURLScheme returns -54 from unbundled processes; LSSetDefaultRoleHandlerForContentType returns 0 but silently changes nothing (verified from JXA and a bare compiled binary); NSWorkspace async setters fail with userCanceledErr (-128) from a bare binary. Writes therefore run through a small bundled helper (Contents/MacOS/iconcraft-defaults, built from scripts/defaults-helper.m, universal x86_64+arm64) using NSWorkspace, so Apple's confirmation dialog appears and the result is re-read and verified before the API reports success. The JXA bridge deliberately stays read-only and refuses setdefault, so nothing silently no-ops.
bugsFoundDuringValidation.defaultsSelectsRenderedDisabled: drawDefaults() ran while defaultsBusy=true, so every category <select> was painted disabled and could not be changed. The stray disabled binding was removed.
bugsFoundDuringValidation.localStorageNeverSurvives: the first cut at remembering sort/group used localStorage, but the UI is served from a fresh random loopback port every launch, so the origin — and its storage — is new each time. Sort/group now persist in the journal like the theme (core.OrganizePrefs, POST api/organize) and are restored on cold start.
bugsFoundDuringValidation.groupHeaderStrandedByNodeReuse: each group had one reused header node; append() moves a node, so when groups interleaved under a name sort the header ended up before the LAST run of its group and the first run (top of list) looked ungrouped (accessibility order put 'NO ORIGINAL FOUND YET · 103' at element 893 of 998). Headers are now built fresh per run each render and rows are stably clustered by group (first-appearance order, chosen sort kept inside each group). Regression test: 'group headers lead every group under any sort order'.
